portInfo.description: Port of Turku positions itself as a smaller, service-intensive Finnish cruise alternative to the capitals. Complimentary shuttle buses run between the inner-harbour pier and the city centre throughout the call; tourist information staff and port Wi‑Fi are offered at the pier. Berth guidance splits larger ships to the inner harbour (~3 km out) and ships ≤130 m to Aura riverbanks closer to downtown. Use the published 2026 call list only as a planning hint — times may change.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 15-20 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: River Aura waterfront / Market Square area — ~90–120 min.
Archipelago boat trips — only with long calls; not verified for self-timing.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Reconcile your ship’s LOA with the 240 m vs 290 m figures before assuming an inner-harbour berth.
